name: Quiet Nivelles 2025

venue.name: Collège saint Gertrude
venue.details: Main building, room G011 (floor 0, at the end of the building). To access the venue, enter the school by Boulevard de la Dodaine because the main gate in Faubourg de Mons will be closed.

information: This competition will only hold quiet events, newcomers should be aware that there won't be usual events such as 3x3, 2x2 or pyraminx. This competition is a twin comp with Nivelles Bigs 2025. You can attend only one of these two competitions.
